sites.note: confidence=medium. The 80 MW Panther Creek waste-coal plant came via the March 2025 Stronghold acquisition. Ticker is KEEL (Bitfarms rebranded and redomiciled 6 Apr 2026); SDIG was delisted 17 Mar 2025.

confidence=medium. The 85 MW Scrubgrass waste-coal plant from the same March 2025 deal; behind-the-meter mining on the co-located plant, so the load is invisible to EIA-930. Penelec is the electric distribution company for Venango County; that link is inferred. Ticker KEEL, see the Panther Creek row.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
